text: Serve the Android APK from the server; single deployable artifact (wheel) with everything in it

Done in 5d17070. The APK is package data (src/shoppinglist_server/apk/
shoppinglist.apk, ~2.1MB committed like web_dist) served at /shoppinglist.apk —
attachment download, android mimetype, max_age=300 (stable URL, no content hash,
so short revalidation). New create_blueprint(serve_android_apk=True) flag with
the same one-instance-per-app guard as web client/landing; register_routes
no-ops gracefully if the file is missing.

Discovery: invite landing page links the download (server-side gated via
"android_apk" in view_functions, like T-44's redeem link); web login page shows
"Get the Android app" after a HEAD probe (static SPA can't know server config).
web_dist rebuilt (index-DkoTVOPd.js).

Single-artifact deploy verified: `python -m build --wheel` -> shoppinglist_server-
1.0.0-py3-none-any.whl containing schema.sql + web_dist + invite.html + the APK.
Server version bumped 0.1.0 -> 1.0.0 to match the app. README documents the
deploy story + the release step: after each `gradlew assembleRelease`, cp the APK
to src/shoppinglist_server/apk/shoppinglist.apk and commit (same discipline as
web_dist rebuilds — noted on T-48 too).

Tests added (5): apk mimetype/attachment/PK-magic, beats-the-SPA-catch-all,
disabled->falls through to SPA, landing link, double-registration guard.
Multi-mount tests updated: second instances must now pass serve_android_apk=False
(consistent with the other two site-root flags; guard raises a clear error).
